headline: Chip stocks slide, but the Dow ends higher
context: AI and chip stocks sank on new US tariff plans and hotter inflation data, but buyers returned late and the Dow closed higher.

winners.name: HP Inc.
winners.why: Quarterly profit beat forecasts at $0.83 a share vs $0.74 expected, though its outlook for next year was cautious.

winners.name: Charter Communications
winners.why: No company news. Fellow cable firm Comcast also rose, but by much less.

winners.name: Axon Enterprise
winners.why: No company news. Defence stocks gained too, with General Dynamics and Lockheed Martin also rising.

losers.name: Lam Research
losers.why: No company news. Chip equipment makers led a broad sell-off in AI and chip stocks, with Applied Materials also falling.

losers.name: Oracle Corporation
losers.why: No company news. It fell with other AI-linked stocks, and software firms Datadog and Autodesk also dropped.

losers.name: Micron Technology
losers.why: BNP Paribas downgraded it to neutral, flagging a risk of too much memory supply, as chip stocks sold off.

sector_note: Median move of stocks in each S&P 500 sector
chart_title: Every sector but health care rose

watch.title: Thanksgiving break
watch.text: US markets are shut on Thursday and close early, at 1pm, on Friday.

question: Was today's late rebound a relief, or just a pause in the AI sell-off?
